text:
maya: heads up — planning to flip on model v13 canary tomorrow 08:30 PT targeting edge pools. initial slice: NA 5%, EU 2%, AU 1%. rollback runbook is ready. please review guardrails.

sam: ok. what's the ramp plan and duration?

maya: plan: start at percentages above for 30m observation window; if signals good -> bump to 25% in region for 1h -> then full region ramp. total expected ~2.5 hours. emergency kill is immediate flag-off.

li: what signals we monitor? dashboards/alerts?

maya: primary: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token-cost delta, quality eval (hallucination/regression) from eval hooks. thresholds: p95 > baseline*1.3 OR 5xx > 0.5% -> abort. also if rerank NDCG drops > 3 points.

tasha: add ff id + make sure rollout respects dedupe keys. i'll add a quick PR for the flag config.

maya: here's the config I'm planning to push:
```
feature_flag: model.v13.edge.canary
audiences:
  - region: us-west-2
    percent: 5
  - region: eu-west-1
    percent: 2
  - region: ap-southeast-2
    percent: 1
fallback_model: model:v12
kill_switch_route: /flags/disable/model.v13
```

deploy-bot: canary created -> id=canary-1761239876 link=https://internal.redwood/canaries/1761239876

sam: @ops-oncall please stand by during the first window. @tasha will you post the PR link and the runtime toggle path?

tasha: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/12345. runtime toggle endpoint: POST /admin/flags/disable/model.v13 (auth: admin-token)

ops-oncall: acknowledged. I'll monitor alerts and be ready to flip.

maya: quick q — do we want to include a narrow test segment for paid-tier customers only? Could reduce risk.

li: +1 to paid-tier only initial slice. smaller blast radius and easier rollback if billing-sensitive.

maya: ok switching audiences: repatching the config now, will update the canary link. :thumbsup: 

sam: thanks everyone. I'll run the preflight checklist at 08:00 PT and ping here.

ops-oncall: FYI set an incident channel auto-forward if abort triggers >15 mins unresolved.

maya: noted. will add escalation to the runbook. thanks.
